arm-function.body:
.thumb_func
.global example
.type example, %function
example:
    push {r4, lr}
    @ body: preserve callee-saved registers
    pop {r4, pc}
.size example, .-example

arm-barrier.body:
dmb sy
dsb sy
isb sy

arm-primask.body:
mrs r0, PRIMASK
cpsid i
@ critical section: preserve r0
msr PRIMASK, r0

arm-mmio.body:
ldr r0, =0x40000000 @ replace with device register address
ldr r1, [r0]
@ update r1 according to the register specification
str r1, [r0]
